A small, flying '''species''' was native to [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]] was small; less than the size of a [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Human/Legends|Human's]] hand. It had a segmented body of a [[Color/Legends|pinkish]] coloration and four jointed [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. It had two pointed wings on the top of its body, with which it could fly. Groups of these creatures could be found in the yellow fields of Garqi.<ref name="Geo" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species appears in an illustration by [[Langdon Foss]] that was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' in [[2004]].<ref name="Geo" />
